name: rice
description: Rice — reuniões transcritas localmente com notas pelo Claude

scripts.build:app: esbuild src/main/app/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:electron --external:onnxruntime-node --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=out/main.cjs && node scripts/copy-app-files.mjs && node scripts/write-build-info.mjs
scripts.dist: scripts/build-native.sh && scripts/stage-native.sh && npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-native-win.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/fetch-whisper-win.ps1 && npm run build:app && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never

author: Rice contributors
